judge.rationale: The candidate diff only adds `.lore/dod.md`, a single paragraph to `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, and a single failing acceptance test (`src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts`), without implementing any production code at all. None of the required changes to `src/types/messages.ts`, `validation.ts`, `messageHandler.ts`, `createServer.ts`, `src/config.ts`, `ErrorCodes`, `StoreCannotList`, or documentation were made. Noticeably, the test even casts `{ history: { enabled: true } } as never` because the config option was never added to the types. Because the feature is completely unimplemented, the test fails at runtime when the server rejects `list_conversations` as an invalid message.
